page.notes: Section headings are set as centred capitals and are given level 2 as parts of the list. Doubtful readings: "di-" at the line end of item 23 (hyphen and following letters unclear), "voluntatis'ne" (apostrophe-like mark), "Neoterico[?]r" (the glyph before "r" is unclear), "Arcaus" (ligature unclear, possibly Arcæus). "pofsit" and "pofsit" are transcribed as printed. The mark in "Vrachos" is kept as printed.
